2607.13689.title: Barnamala: Parameter-Efficient Handwritten Devanagari Recognition at Benchmark Saturation
2607.13689.paper_summary: We built a compact convolutional network (1.11 M parameters) for 46-class DHCD Devanagari recognition and reached 99.73%, the highest reported at 15.6x smaller than prior state-of-the-art. We have effectively reached the saturation point: every model tested, large teacher ensembles included, hits the same 11-error intrinsic floor. No configuration achieves a statistically clear win under exact McNemar tests with Wilson confidence intervals. Even without knowledge distillation, our student matches the nearest large-model baseline (17.32 M parameters; McNemar $p = 0.345$). Outside of DHCD, zero-shot on CMATERdb digits gives 76.6% and fine-tuning reaches 97.8%; corruption robustness is also far better than large baselines (mean corruption accuracy 75.7% vs. 38.7%). All artifacts are at https://github.com/Ampixa/barnamala.
2607.13689.paper_summary_zh: 我們建立了一個緊湊的卷積網絡（1.11 M 參數）用於 46 類 DHCD Devanagari 辨識，達到了 99.73%，這是報告中最高的，並且比之前的最先進技術小 15.6 倍。我們有效地達到了飽和點：每個測試的模型，包括大型教師集，都達到了相同的 11 錯誤內在底線。在精確的 McNemar 測試中，沒有任何配置能夠在威爾遜信心區間下取得統計上的明顯勝利。即使沒有知識蒸餾，我們的學生模型也達到了最近的大型模型基準（17.32 M 參數；McNemar $p = 0.345$）。在 DHCD 之外，零樣本在 CMATERdb 數字上給出了 76.6%，而微調達到了 97.8%；在腐敗魯棒性方面也遠遠超過大型基準（平均腐敗準確率 75.7% 對 38.7%）。所有文物都在 https://github.com/Ampixa/barnamala。
2607.13689.author: Ashish Thapa et.al.
